purpose: Teach: 吐き気/日本食/静寂/脱力/化合/矢先/在来/祭典

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バスで吐き気しただろ?
lines.en: You got nauseous on the bus, didn't you?
lines.style: Quick, teasing tone. Playful accusation. Light rhythm, like she's caught him in something small and harmless. Knowing smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、海外でも日本食ばっか食ってんな、桜
lines.en: You eat nothing but Japanese food even when you're overseas, don't you Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection. Turning it back on her with a half-smile. Not harsh — more like a gentle counter-punch. Quick tempo, understated.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、図書館の静寂が好きだろ?
lines.en: You love the quiet in the library, don't you?
lines.style: Softer than the first. Genuinely curious, almost tender. She's testing whether she knows him. Slower pace. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト後に脱力してたな、桜
lines.en: You were completely zoned out right after the test, weren't you Sakura.
lines.style: Observant, amused. Not mocking — she's noticed something real. Light, conversational rhythm. A small laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、化学で化合物の単元やったろ?
lines.en: You studied the compound unit in chemistry, right?
lines.style: Persistent, playfully testing. She's building a pattern. Steady tempo, slight emphasis on each observation. Waiting to see if he'll catch on.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強始めた矢先に眠ってたな、桜
lines.en: You fell asleep the moment you started studying, didn't you Sakura.
lines.style: Caught-you tone, but gentle. He's matching her rhythm now, turning her own game back on her. Almost laughing. Warm and knowing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で在来植物の単元やったろ?
lines.en: You did the native plants unit in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Final test. She's closing in on something. Deliberate pace, slight anticipation. Waiting for his response. Intensity building quietly underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、地域の祭典で太鼓叩いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were playing drums at the local festival, weren't you Sakura.
lines.style: Warm recognition. He's found the answer. Quiet pride in his voice — not showy, but genuine. Slower, more solid. The moment where he proves he was paying attention all along.
